blocks.text: The module documentation explains that shared auth and access helpers were moved here to avoid api.server circular imports.
blocks.title: Dependency boundary

blocks.anchor: # Lazily-built JWKS client — fetches and caches Supabase's public signing
blocks.text: The JWKS client is built only when needed and requires the configured Supabase URL.
blocks.title: Lazy public-key client

blocks.text: JWT headers select a legacy HS256 secret path or a fetched asymmetric signing key. Expiry and token errors become 401 responses, and a subject is required.
blocks.title: JWT verification

blocks.text: require_auth extracts a Bearer token, verifies it, and stores the subject on request.state. The email lookup paginates admin users and matches email locally.
blocks.title: Bearer and admin email lookup

blocks.text: The reverse admin lookup pages until requested ids are found or the list ends, then derives email, display name, and avatar fields from user data.
blocks.title: Roster identity lookup

blocks.anchor: def _resolve_chat_or_404(chat_id: str, user_id: str, require_edit: bool = False) -> str:
blocks.text: The helper asks chat_store for ownership or collaboration, hides existence from unauthorized callers with 404, rejects viewer edits with 403, and returns the real owner id.
blocks.title: Chat access resolution

gotchas: Invalid access is deliberately reported as 404 for chat resolution.
Viewer access becomes 403 only when edit is required.
Service-role credentials are used only for admin lookups.
purpose: This dependency module breaks the route/server import cycle while preserving shared authentication and access checks. It verifies legacy or asymmetric Supabase tokens, performs paginated admin lookups for invitations and rosters, and resolves a chat's real owner and edit rights.
summary: Centralizes Supabase JWT authentication, admin user lookups, and chat access resolution for API routes.

symbols.summary: Lazily creates the Supabase public-key client from the configured project URL.
Verifies a Supabase JWT and returns its subject user id.
Authenticates a request's Bearer header and stores the subject on request state.
Finds one Supabase user id by exact email through paginated admin API results.
Builds display identity mappings for a set of Supabase user ids.
Checks chat ownership or collaboration and returns the chat's actual owner id.

unknowns: Token issuance and chat-store access implementation are outside this file.
